verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a hosted scraping/crawling API with its own primitives (scrape, crawl, extract, browser sandbox) rather than a framework for developers to write Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium/Scrapy scripts; there is no documented support for plugging in or building on these open-source libraries. A community comment even notes Firecrawl internally uses Puppeteer (not user-selectable) and lacks the openness these libraries provide, contradicting any claim of multi-library dev flexibility.
